item.title: Persistent Systems launches Rs 4,265-cr QIP; floor price set at Rs 5,550/share
item.description: Persistent Systems has opened a qualified institutional placement to raise up to USD 450 million, or about Rs 4,265 crore. The IT company has set the QIP floor price at Rs 5,550 per share and may offer investors a discount of up to 5% under the approved pricing terms.

item.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
item.description: Sensex and Nifty ended above pre-closing auction session levels after extreme volatility, despite an Rs 8 lakh crore market selloff. Elevated crude prices, foreign investor outflows and weak market breadth kept sentiment cautious.

item.title: Market Trading Guide: Wipro among 5 stock recommendations for Thursday
item.description: Technical analysts have recommended Wipro, NHPC, Sagility, LTTS and Hexaware Technologies for potential gains, citing bullish chart patterns, support levels and momentum indicators. The recommendations include specific entry prices, stop losses and targets to manage trading risks.

item.title: Mahindra Finance Q2 net profit surges 55% to Rs 882 crore on volumes, lower credit cost
item.description: Business assets under management grew 15% year on year to Rs 1.47 lakh crore. Non-vehicle finance disbursements, including SME loans, personal loans and housing finance, increased 52%.

item.title: PC Jewellers Q2 Results: Net profit shoots up 58% to Rs 331 crore; company says it is now debt-free
item.description: PC Jewellers Ltd has achieved an impressive 58 percent growth in net profit for Q2 of the 2026-27 fiscal year, driven by sales that surged beyond Rs 1,054 crore. The company is now debt-free after early repayment to banks and is set to unveil a new jewellery brand aimed at attracting younger consumers.

item.title: IHCL Q2 Results: Tata Group-owned hotel chain's net profit jumps 19% to Rs 379 crore
item.description: Indian Hotels Company Ltd, under the Tata Group, has announced a remarkable 19.35% rise in consolidated profit for the September quarter, soaring to Rs 379.85 crore from Rs 318.26 crore last year. Revenue from operations also surged to Rs 2,484.32 crore, up from Rs 2,040.89 crore. The Managing Director highlighted promising growth prospects and anticipates domestic hotel business growth exceeding 20%, notwithstanding challenges faced in the aviation sector.

item.title: Can Jio IPO unlock hidden value in Reliance Industries shares?
Sky Gold and Diamonds among 5 stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 45% in a month
item.description: Despite the Sensex falling 143 points on Wednesday, five BSE 1000 stocks hit fresh 52-week highs. PC Jeweller led monthly gains at 45%, followed by Sky Gold and Diamonds, HFCL, South Indian Bank and Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem.

item.title: IGI Q2 Results: Consolidated PAT surges 43% to Rs 185 crore
item.description: The International Gemological Institute recently announced an impressive 43.14 percent growth in profit after tax for the previous quarter. Operational revenue rose by 31 percent compared to last year. Demand for both lab-grown and natural diamonds remains strong, particularly as the festive season approaches, prompting retailers and manufacturers to anticipate a surge in sales across their segments.

item.title: Aye Finance Q2 Results: Net profit more than doubles to Rs 87 crore
item.description: Aye Finance Ltd's net profit surged to Rs 87 crore in the second quarter of the financial year, a remarkable increase from Rs 35 crore in the same timeframe last year. Total income also climbed to Rs 527 crore, reflecting an 18.42% year-over-year growth. The interest income saw a rise to Rs 479 crore, while assets under management swelled by 26% to hit Rs 7,597 crore as of September 2026.

item.title: Market wrap: Infosys, HCL Tech, Bajaj Finance, BSE top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Wednesday
item.description: Indian markets extended losses for a second session on Wednesday, with the Nifty falling 0.34% to 22,811 and the Sensex slipping 0.19% to 73,710. IT stocks led sectoral gains, with Infosys and HCL Tech topping the gainers, while Bajaj Finance, BSE and Eternal featured among the biggest losers.

item.title: Want exposure to India's biggest banks? Zerodha launches new ETF
item.description: Zerodha Fund House has launched the BSE Top 10 Banks ETF, tracking India’s largest listed banks. The NFO runs from October 12 to October 26, 2026, with a minimum investment of Rs 1,000, offering focused banking exposure.

item.title: CAS swings: Nifty’s indicative price jumps 500 points in seconds, closes higher than pre-CAS level
item.description: The Indian stock market experienced notable volatility during the closing auction, marked by a steep selloff that wiped out more than Rs 8 lakh crore in market capitalization. Despite Sensex and Nifty ending higher than pre-CAS levels, investor sentiment remained cautious due to escalating bond yields and ongoing selling by foreign institutional investors.

item.title: MFs raise stakes in 10 stocks in Q2; shares rally up to 130% in FY27, including 3 multibaggers
item.description: Ten BSE 500 stocks have rallied between 59% and 129% in FY27 so far as mutual funds increased their shareholding in the September 2026 quarter. Cemindia Projects, Aditya Infotech and Aegis Logistics lead the list of gainers.

item.title: Eternal Q2 Results: Profit soars 92% YoY to Rs 125 crore; revenue zooms 78%
item.description: Eternal Q2 Results: Eternal, the parent company of Zomato and Blinkit, reported a 92.3% year-on-year (YoY) jump in net profit to Rs 125 crore in the second quarter of FY27 (Q2FY27), compared with Rs 65 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year.

item.title: Rs 8 lakh crore selloff! Sensex plunges 1,400 points from day’s peak as bulls lose steam; 3 triggers
item.description: On Wednesday, the Indian stock market saw a significant decline after an initial rise in the morning. Sensex and Nifty both climbed nearly 1% early on, reaching highs of 74,682 and 23,121 respectively. However, the market reversed course in the afternoon session, with selling pressure mounting. By the end of the day, Sensex dropped around 1,400 points from day's high, while Nifty fell below the 22,700 level.

item.title: Adani Green Q2 Results: Profit rises 15% YoY to Rs 673 crore; revenue jumps 39%
item.description: Adani Green Energy reported a 15% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 673 crore in Q2, while revenue grew 39% to Rs 4,520 crore. Power supply revenue rose 45% to Rs 4,019 crore, and energy sales increased 33% to 12,090 million units, reflecting expanding operational capacity.

item.title: Vishal Mega Mart shares sink 8% as Q2 margin takes a hit despite profit growth
item.description: Vishal Mega Mart shares fell sharply on Wednesday after the retailer reported a 110-basis-point year-on-year contraction in EBITDA margin to 12.1% in Q2FY27. Net profit rose 3.7% to Rs 157.9 crore, while revenue increased 14% to Rs 3,398.5 crore. The company attributed margin pressure to a shift in festival timing.

item.title: Multibagger alert! PC Jeweller shares jump 6% to fresh 52-week high, rally over 100% in 2026
item.description: PC Jeweller shares hit a fresh 52-week high of Rs 19.13, rising over 100% in 2026 and gaining 44% in a month. The rally follows the company’s repayment of outstanding dues to all 14 consortium banks, achieving debt-free status ahead of schedule and strengthening its balance sheet.

item.title: HD Fire Protect shares list at 23% premium; expert highlights key factors to watch
item.description: HD Fire Protect shares listed at a 23% premium over the IPO issue price of Rs 271, debuting at Rs 334.40 on the BSE and Rs 335 on the NSE. Experts say future performance will depend on customer expansion, margin stability, operating cash flows and demand for fire protection equipment.

item.title: Rs 30,213 crore, 100 minutes, Rs 2.5 lakh crore: How Jio IPO broke 3 records even before listing
item.description: Reliance Industries’ Jio Platforms has set new IPO records, with its Rs 30,213 crore issue becoming India’s largest-ever public offering and getting fully subscribed within 100 minutes of opening. The IPO surpasses Hyundai Motor India’s Rs 27,870 crore issue in 2024. At the upper end of its Rs 1,065–1,119 price band, Jio Platforms is valued at around Rs 10.3 lakh crore. The issue closes on October 23.

item.title: Reliance Industries shares jump 3% as Jio’s Rs 30,213 crore IPO gets fully subscribed on Day 1. What lies ahead?
item.description: Reliance Industries shares rose on Wednesday as Jio Platforms’ Rs 30,213 crore IPO was fully subscribed within an hour of opening. was fully subscribed within an hour of opening. With strong investor demand for the issue, attention is turning to Jio’s valuation, RIL’s diverse business portfolio and the potential value-unlocking opportunities for investors following the much-awaited listing.

item.title: Piramal Finance shares jump 4% as Q2 profit rises 67% YoY to Rs 545 crore, NII jumps 35% YoY
item.description: Piramal Finance shares rose nearly 4% after Q2 FY27 net profit surged 67% year-on-year to Rs 545 crore. Assets under management grew 24%, while retail disbursements increased 34%. The company strengthened its capital base, expanded AI adoption, improved operational efficiency, and appointed former SBI Chairman Dinesh Kumar Khara as Independent Director.

item.title: Missed reversal in IT stocks? Jefferies gives 3 ideas with up to 50% re-rating potential
item.description: Jefferies sees further valuation upside in Indian IT stocks despite a muted sector growth outlook. Infosys and TCS offer over 20% rerating potential, while Sagility could deliver more than 50% in a best-case scenario. The brokerage raised target prices for Infosys and TCS, citing scope for growth expectations to stabilise.

item.title: Bajaj Finance shares fall 3% after Q2 results. What Jefferies, Nomura, other brokerages now expect?
item.description: Bajaj Finance shares dropped on Wednesday after the NBFC reported a 29% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 6,367 crore. Nomura and Jefferies retained Buy ratings, with Jefferies cutting its target price, while 360 One WAM upgraded the stock to Buy, citing improving risk-reward and strong growth.

item.title: Transrail Lighting shares rally 9% after bagging orders worth Rs 927 crore
item.description: Transrail Lighting shares rose nearly 9% after the company secured fresh orders worth Rs 927 crore, taking its financial year order intake to Rs 3,356 crore. However, foreign institutional investors trimmed their stake in the company during the September 2026 quarter.

item.title: Why L&T Technology shares jumped 11% to hit the Rs 4,000 level afterQ2 results
item.description: L&T Technology Services shares rose sharply past Rs 4,000 after Q2 results beat expectations, driven by margin expansion, AI-led deal wins and strong sustainability business growth. Management expects a stronger second half of FY27, while Motilal Oswal, Nuvama and Nomura raised their target prices but maintained cautious ratings.

item.title: Hindustan Zinc shares jump 4% after Q2 net profit more than doubles. Why Jefferies cut target price?
item.description: Hindustan Zinc reported a 142% year-on-year jump in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 6,412 crore, while revenue rose 77% to Rs 15,093 crore. Despite strong earnings, Jefferies cut its target price to Rs 650 from Rs 750, citing silver price volatility and lower price assumptions for the coming years.

item.title: Why is market rising today? Sensex jumps 800 points, Nifty above 23,050. 5 key factors behind D-Street rebound
item.description: The Sensex and Nifty rallied nearly 1% as strong Q2 earnings, gains in IT stocks, rupee appreciation and attractive largecap valuations lifted sentiment. However, elevated crude oil prices and rising bond yields remain key risks. Analysts expect market movements to remain stock-specific and driven by corporate earnings.

item.title: Maruti Suzuki Share Price Highlights: Maruti Suzuki Stock Price History
Vaibhav Vyapaar Shares to list today; Check GMP ahead of debut
item.description: Vaibhav Vyapaar shares are scheduled to list on the NSE SME platform on October 21, with the IPO commanding a grey market premium of around 6%. The Rs 42.10 crore issue was subscribed 2.27 times. The NBFC plans to use Rs 32 crore from the proceeds to strengthen its capital base.

item.title: UltraTech Cement shares jump 3% as brokerages revise target prices after Q2 results. What Jefferies, Citi are saying
item.description: Shares of UltraTech Cement increased by 3% after the company reported strong quarterly earnings for Q2 FY27. The company's net profit saw a 21% growth compared to the previous year, driven by operational revenue increases. Jefferies raised its target price for the stock, indicating significant upside potential. Meanwhile, Nomura and Citi slightly lowered their estimates due to rising costs and external economic factors.

item.title: Jio IPO beyond telecom: Why the Ambanis are pitching AI, cloud and 7,220 patents as Jio’s tech future
item.description: Jio Platforms ₹30,213 crore IPO marks a significant shift toward technology-driven digital services. With a focus on leveraging its connectivity through AI and cloud technologies, the company is also highlighting its extensive patent holdings. While Reliance Jio Infocomm continues to generate substantial revenue, the company aspires to broaden its reach into enterprise solutions and diverse digital products.

item.title: Anand Rathi Wealth among 5 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
item.description: Five NSE F&O stocks recorded significant increases in futures open interest on October 19, reflecting heightened trading activity and growing participation across wealth management, industrial, energy, and real estate sectors.

item.title: HD Fire Protect shares list at 24% premium over IPO price on NSE
item.description: HD Fire Protect shares debuted at a premium of up to 23.6% on Wednesday after its Rs 712 crore IPO attracted 131.70 times subscription. The issue was entirely an offer for sale by promoter shareholders. The company reported a 12% rise in FY26 total income to Rs 505 crore.Do you like this personality?
